title: Add separator between known and unknown networks
line: The Networks widget now lists networks you have saved under their own "Saved" header, separate from new networks.
explanation: The Networks widget only sectioned its list by connection state, so every network that wasn't connected appeared under one "Available" header, with saved connections and never-used access points mixed in the same block. The sorting already placed saved connections before unknown ones, but nothing marked where one group ended. The applet's proxy model now reports a "Saved" section for disconnected items that have a saved connection, so the list reads Connected / Saved / Available; the item also signals a section change when its saved connection appears or goes away.

commits.message:
applet: show saved networks in their own section

Networks with a saved connection were listed together with unknown
ones under "Available". Put them in a "Saved" section above the others,
which the sorting already keeps together, so the list is easier to scan.

BUG: 477333

media.caption: Before: saved networks (Library, Cafe) and unknown networks share one "Available" section
After: saved networks get their own "Saved" section above the unknown ones
